descriptionPhysique.description: Architecture and condition of the monument

MonumentForm.detailSansObjet: Not applicable to an unprotected property
MonumentForm.detailPlaceholder: E.g. Listed (classé) as an MH by order of 16 June 1928
MonumentForm.proprietaireAide: You can choose more than one. A funding scheme is suggested to you as soon as one of the owners can apply for it.
MonumentForm.typeEdificeAide: You can choose more than one: an estate may combine a château, a chapel and a dovecote. They answer the questions about the nature of the property in advance, so you are no longer asked them.
MonumentForm.etatAide: A monument that is at risk or in poor condition opens up emergency schemes. This answer applies to all your works projects on this monument.

protectionEnonce.abords: Located in the surroundings of a historic monument

protectionPhrase.classe: The highest level of protection for historic monuments: State funding is widely open to you.
protectionPhrase.inscrit: An official protection that makes you eligible for many public funding schemes.
protectionPhrase.abords: The property lies within the protected surroundings of a historic monument.
protectionPhrase.spr: A site recognised for the value of its architectural and landscape heritage.
protectionPhrase.nonProtege: No official protection yet. Some funding schemes are nevertheless still available.

perilPhrase.oui: Emergency schemes, such as the Loto du patrimoine and regional safeguarding funds, are only open to monuments in this situation.
perilPhrase.non: The monument is generally sound. Emergency funding does not apply to you, but standard restoration schemes remain open.
perilPhrase.inconnu: The question has not been asked yet. Answering it opens up or rules out emergency schemes.

MonumentFiche.sousTitre: What describes the property. It applies to all your projects on this monument.

EnTeteMonument.aideValider: Press Enter to confirm, Esc to cancel.

FicheMonumentSections.typeEdificeAide: It answers the questions about the nature of the property in advance (church, wash house, war memorial…). An estate may combine several: château, chapel, dovecote.

culte.pourquoi: Some schemes exclude buildings still used for worship, others are reserved for them.

roman.pourquoi: Some programmes are reserved for Romanesque heritage, even if only parts of it remain.

FicheMonumentSections.texteActuel: Current text: “{{texte}}”. Choosing a century replaces it.
FicheMonumentSections.etatAide: If it is at risk or in poor condition, it opens up emergency schemes.
FicheMonumentSections.detailPlaceholder: E.g. Listed (classé) as an MH by order of 16 June 1928
FicheMonumentSections.proprietaireAide: A property can have several owners. A funding scheme is suggested to you as soon as one of them can apply for it.

MonumentDetailPage.introuvableTexte: This monument does not exist or has been deleted.
MonumentDetailPage.vosProjetsSousTitre: Each project has its own funding schemes and its own application.
MonumentDetailPage.autreChantier: Another works project or another activity?
MonumentDetailPage.projetExplication: A project is one undertaking. Re-roofing is one. Hosting a theatre company in residence is another. The funders are not the same.
MonumentDetailPage.aucunProjet: No works projects on this monument yet.
MonumentDetailPage.documentsIntro: Documents for the monument and for its works projects.
MonumentDetailPage.documentsVide: Documents for the monument and its projects will appear here.

paywallEquipe.description: Invite your architect, your craftspeople or an assistant. They get access to the monument, its projects and its documents, with the role you give them.

paywallProjet.titre: Run as many projects as you need
paywallProjet.descriptionIllimite: The Watch plan gives you unlimited works projects, and alerts you before every deadline.
paywallProjet.descriptionPlafond: Your plan covers {{max}} projects per monument. The Watch plan makes them unlimited, and alerts you before every deadline.

MonumentDetailPage.supprimerDescription: All its works projects and the related applications will also be deleted. This action cannot be undone.

MonumentWizardPage.erreurMerimee: Error while retrieving the Mérimée record
MonumentWizardPage.merimeeTitre: Save time: search for your monument in the Mérimée database
MonumentWizardPage.merimeeAide: If it is protected, it will be there: choose it and the fields below will fill themselves in. Otherwise, fill them in directly.
MonumentWizardPage.intro: This information is used to sort the funding schemes for you. You only provide it once: it applies to all your projects on this monument.

paywall.titre: A second monument, and every one after that
paywall.description: The free plan covers one monument. The Multi-monument plan lifts the limit, brings all your properties together on a dashboard and unlocks deletion.

MonumentsListPage.sousTitre: Each monument, its works projects and the funding that goes with them.
MonumentsListPage.videTexte: Describe your monument, then start as many works projects as you need to identify the funding available.

paywall.titre: Manage all your properties in one place
paywall.description: The free plan covers one monument. The Multi-monument plan makes them unlimited and unlocks the dashboard, which brings together their projects and deadlines.
